items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: I sure did enjoy his recording with him. I never did play a regular job with him, but I recorded. I made a lot of records.

ctx.x: Did you see him after that last session? Did you see him in the golf?

Oh, sure. I saw him a lot there. I saw him around the rhythm. Sometime I'd meet him downtown, yeah, on Broadway. He was just a great guy. I sure did enjoy his recording with him. I never did play a regular job with him, but I recorded. I made a lot of records.
He played many band jobs. He played many band jobs. He played many band jobs. He played many band jobs. And the group.
